name: Arcee Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1989, Arcee Industries 
Ltd is in the business of production 
of Rigid PVC Pipe and Steel Pipes[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AIL had taken on lease Land, Building & Machinery of Arcee Ispat Udyog Private Limited, a unit for manufacturing of Black Steel tubes 
& pipes, for a period of 10 years in FY20. The company started its commercial production of 
Black Steel tubes & pipes on January 14th, 2021. It was working in 2 segment:
a) PVC pipe 
b) Steel pipe
But due to continuous loss in the steel pipe manufacturing, the company cancelled the Lease of Land, Building and Machinery with 
Arcee Ispat Udyog Private Limited on 22nd 
May, 2023,

pros: Stock is trading at 0.87 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -32.2% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -16.9% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 195 days.
Working capital days have increased from 780 days to 1,995 days
